name: EEG Foundation Challenge
description: The task involves developing models for two challenges: (1) zero-shot decoding of new tasks and subjects from EEG data, and (2) predicting mental health-relevant psychopathology factors from EEG data. The goal is to create models that generalize across tasks and individuals, leveraging a large-scale, high-density EEG dataset.

cr:input.name: HBN-EEG Dataset
cr:input.description: High-density (128-channel) EEG recordings from over 3,000 participants aged 5-21 years, engaging in six distinct cognitive tasks (three passive: Resting State, Surround Suppression, Movie Watching; and three active: Contrast Change Detection, Sequence Learning, Symbol Search). Data includes demographic attributes (age, gender, handedness) and four psychopathology factors (internalization, externalization, attention, and p-factor). Data is formatted according to the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) standard and includes event annotations using Hierarchical Event Descriptors (HED).

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predicted outputs include labels for cognitive tasks or conditions (Challenge 1) and regression outputs for four psychopathology factors (internalization, externalization, attention, and p-factor) and demographic attributes (age, gender, handedness) for Challenge 2.

field.name: task_label
field.description: Predicted task or condition label for Challenge 1. Example: 'Resting State', 'Contrast Change Detection'.

field.name: p_factor
field.description: Predicted p-factor representing a transdiagnostic psychopathology factor. Example: 1.2.

field.name: age
field.description: Predicted age of the participant. Example: 15.

field.name: gender
field.description: Predicted gender of the participant. Example: 'Male', 'Female'.

field.name: handedness
field.description: Predicted handedness of the participant based on the Edinburg Inventory. Example: 'Right-handed', 'Left-handed'.
